title: Expressable Speech and Occupational Therapy - Videos
description: At Expressable, our mission is to make life-changing speech and occupational therapy accessible, affordable, and convenient for everyone. We offer personalized, one-on-one online speech and occupational therapy. We're in network with hundreds of insurance plans and have more than 4,500 5-star reviews from our clients. Best of all, you can schedule appointments with licensed a speech-language pathologist or occupational therapist from the comfort of home, on your schedule--mornings, nights, and weekends.
